title: Codex setTurnTitle rejected because typed result did not confirm retitled=true
summary: During ViceSharp mock-scope approval logging, updateTurn with title did not change queryTitle on primary readback. Supported workflow.sessionlog.setTurnTitle with queryTitle changed the local current-turn.yaml but returned code rejected persisted false queued false and a real failsafePath.
